label: Synth brass 1, sampled, close and dry
audition_title: libsonare synth brass 1 vs the sampled reference
_notes: Every fourth semitone across the compass this program is probed on, 48 to 72, and no further. Both ends were rendered before the grid was written and both speak: the peaks run 0.109, 0.103, 0.106 at the low, middle and high probe notes, and the share of energy on the played key's own series is 0.994 or better at all three. A note outside the compass is left out rather than transposed, because there the reference is stretching a sample and a model fitted against it would be fitted against the sampler.
_velocities: Five, and the axis is timbre rather than level: on this slot velocity 32 sits -22.5 dB under velocity 100 at the middle probe note, and the soft end stays a clean tone rather than thinning into noise. The softest row is kept because it is the most distinct timbre the instrument has.
_dry: Nothing to switch off, measured rather than assumed. Not one of the plugin's advertised parameters matches `reverb` with this rack loaded, and the render agrees: the release reaches the numerical floor without a tail behind it. `dry` therefore has no section to act on and is left off rather than claiming an effect was disabled, which makes this a dry anchor - every level and release measured against it is the instrument alone.
_stimulus: The metrics take their sustain window at 30 to 90 per cent of the note, capped at 0.6 to 1.8 s after onset, so a three-second gate puts it on the held tone with margin. This slot holds for the whole of it: the render was traced bucket by bucket before the gate was chosen and it is still sounding when the key lifts. The key stops the note and nothing follows it: 100 ms after note-off the render is at the numerical floor (-159 dB). Half a second of tail carries all of that.
_calibration: From `capture.py calibrate` on this rack: the reference renders identically in real time and faster than it, the same note twice is bit-identical - so there is no round robin to put a floor under the loss - and the settle minimum is a quarter of a second. `realtime` is kept on anyway, because a note streamed late is caught only by `verify` and would otherwise be committed as a measurement.
_timbres: One, and the ladder is monotone above it, so this capture cannot move the voice past `voiced` however complete its coverage. That is a property of the source rather than of the work: the rack holds one slot per GM program, so there is no second of this instrument in it to disagree with, and `source_for` takes every timbre of a capture from one plugin, so a soundfont render cannot stand in as a second. What the reference buys is a measured target for `autofit` and `--diagnose` where the voice could previously only be fitted by ear.
_dimensions: All ten a sustained voice can be judged on. `damper` is the load-bearing one on a blown or bowed voice: the note stops when the energy stops, and a model whose release is a decay rather than a stop gives itself away there before anywhere else. The slot is a synthetic brass source, and the partial ladder `balance` reads is where that shows. `stereo` is gated rather than excused here because this slot does render an image: its two channels are not identical.
_dimensions_na: The exclusions as data, since a dimension argued only in prose reads as a gap. Coverage is read against `toneclass.canonical_dimensions`, which for a sustained voice already drops `decay`, `aftersound` and `doubling` - a voice fed continuously has no free fall for them to describe - so those are not listed here.
_identity: Which product this is captured from lives in the untracked sibling `synth_brass_1.local.json`: the plugin's component triple and the slot's preset. Everything here is the method. Re-capturing needs the overlay; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/synth_brass_1.json` and need nothing.
_slots: Slot identity is measured, never taken from a name or a position. The rack is addressed by MIDI channel; this program answers on channel 15, and it was rendered at its own three probe notes before anything else was written, reading 0.994 or better of its energy on the series of the key pressed. The same three renders are what say the slot sustains: several slots of these racks hold a sample that is gone within half a second of a three-second key, and a grid written for one of those would take every measurement on silence.
